traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 025.0-DEV-CATCH-ANNOTATION-POSITION are fully implemented and verified: - Before-catch annotations remain supported and are preferred when both before and inside positions are present, enforced via gatherCatchClauseCommentText and validated by dedicated unit tests (REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION, REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY). - Inside-catch annotations are detected using both getCommentsInside and a robust line-based fallback when that API is unavailable, satisfying REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC and REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION. - Auto-fix for CatchClause branches calculates indent and insert position inside the catch body and inserts placeholder comments before the first executable statement (or on the first line inside an empty block), matching Prettier’s layout and validated by branch-annotation-catch-insert-position tests (REQ-PRETTIER-AUTOFIX). - Integration tests running real Prettier and ESLint demonstrate that code formatted by Prettier passes traceability checks whether annotations begin before catch or inside the body, including empty catch cases (Prettier Compatibility criterion). - The main require-branch-annotation rule suite and all other branch-related tests pass, showing no regressions for other branch types (if/switch/loops/try). - User-facing API documentation explicitly documents both valid CatchClause annotation positions, precedence, and formatter-aware auto-fix behavior. Given the existing implementation, focused unit tests, end-to-end Prettier integration tests, and passing test suite, the story is fully satisfied and is marked as PASSED.
